stations.title: Rhona
stations.say: Can I read it out without squinting?

stations.title: Year's figures
stations.text: Right numbers, nine decimals, no columns.

stations.title: Your functions
stations.gap: Numbers no one can read out

captions: Rhona has to read the year out at the team's meeting, from one printed sheet.
Today the numbers are right but show nine decimals, and the columns wander.
You format each value: decimal places, widths, zeros in front, and a table.
Now the sheet lines up and Rhona reads the year straight down.
Hours, incident numbers and columns look the same on every page Rhona reads out.
